title: Siren Warning for Fake Bank Fraud Calls
title_te: నకిలీ బ్యాంక్ మోసపు కాల్స్‌కు సైరన్ హెచ్చరిక
problem: A scam caller pretended to be a bank officer and tricked our neighbour into sharing his OTP, stealing his entire month's wage in minutes.
idea: A scam call alarm. Teachable Machine Audio listens for danger words like 'tell OTP' or 'account blocked' and PictoBlox plays a loud siren. Tap what the caller says to try it.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: What does the caller say?
widgets.intro: In my real project, the computer listens to the phone call on speaker. Here, tap what the caller says.
widgets.question: The caller says:

options.label: "Tell me the OTP you just got"
options.result: 🚨 SIREN! SCAM! Banks NEVER ask for OTP. Cut the call now.
options.te: 🚨 మోసం! బ్యాంకులు ఎప్పుడూ ఓటీపీ అడగవు. వెంటనే కాల్ కట్ చేయండి.

options.label: "Your account is blocked, update KYC now"
options.result: 🚨 SIREN! SCAM! Do not click links. Go to your bank branch yourself.
options.te: 🚨 మోసం! లింకులు నొక్కవద్దు. మీరే బ్యాంకుకు వెళ్ళండి.

options.label: "Install this app so I can help you"
options.result: 🚨 SIREN! Screen-sharing apps let thieves see your phone. Never install.
options.te: 🚨 ఆ యాప్ ద్వారా దొంగలు మీ ఫోన్ చూస్తారు. ఇన్‌స్టాల్ చేయవద్దు.

options.label: "You won a lottery, pay a small fee"
options.result: Warning! Real prizes never ask for fees. It is a trick.

options.label: "Please visit the branch with your passbook"
options.result: This sounds normal. But still, go to the branch yourself and check.
options.te: ఇది మామూలుగా ఉంది. అయినా బ్రాంచ్‌కు వెళ్ళి నిర్ధారించుకోండి.

items.title: OTP
items.text: OTP is like a key to your money. Never tell anyone.
items.te: ఓటీపీ మీ డబ్బుకు తాళం చెవి. ఎవరికీ చెప్పవద్దు.

items.title: PIN / Password
items.text: Banks never ask for your PIN on the phone.

items.title: Card number & CVV
items.text: Do not read your card details to callers.

items.title: Cheated? Call 1930
items.text: Call 1930 or report at cybercrime.gov.in quickly.
items.te: మోసపోతే 1930కి ఫోన్ చేయండి లేదా cybercrime.gov.in లో ఫిర్యాదు చేయండి.

questions.q: Does a real bank officer ask for your OTP?
questions.why: Banks never ask for OTP, PIN or passwords.

questions.q: Money was stolen after a call. Which number do you call?
questions.why: 1930 is the national cyber fraud helpline. Call fast.

questions.q: Caller says 'account blocked, click this link'. What do you do?
options: Cut the call and visit the bank

how: Open teachablemachine.withgoogle.com and choose Audio Project.
Record 'Background Noise', then classes like 'Tell OTP', 'Account blocked' and 'Normal talk' (record each phrase 8+ times in different voices).
Train the model, then Export and copy the link.
In PictoBlox, add the Machine Learning extension and paste the audio model link.
When class is 'Tell OTP' or 'Account blocked', play a siren sound and show 'SCAM – cut the call!'.
Ask Gemini for more danger phrases in Telugu and add them as new classes.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. List 10 common phrases fake bank callers use in India (in English and Telugu), and for each give a one-line safe reply. Remind people that banks never ask for OTP or PIN and to call 1930 or visit cybercrime.gov.in if cheated.
